changes: No calendar-time extension or pooled estimator input was formed. The accepted Stata code treats t as a synthetic row-order period; no calendar year was assigned to it.
limitations: The task sample main is the paper’s observed Compustat/CRSP firm-year sample, 1963–2014 (Tables 7 and 8). That empirical analysis is a separate Code/02-Compustat.do branch and is outside the predecessor’s accepted analysis_only scope, which ran Code/01-Models.do on synthetic simulations. The feasibility assessment documents the separate empirical branch and old author DTA deliveries, but its local product metadata and row-limit probes do not establish current usable 1963–2019 coverage or author-compatible normalized inputs. This report does not claim those local sources are absent or unable to support 2019.

The six exact simulation CSVs named in local_inputs.json were read from their recorded package source paths and matched the manifest hashes and aggregate shapes; they are not staged under this job’s work/package. No native replay was launched because this assigned stage has no calendar-observed sample to extend.

Inherited gap G_MATLAB_SMM_PREREQUISITES remains: four SMM entrypoints were not launched because required GA, Parallel Computing, and Statistics and Machine Learning functions/toolboxes were unavailable in the trusted MATLAB metadata and no MATLAB runtime/profile was approved in the frozen plan.

Inherited gap G_FIGURE_8_MISSING_FRACPOLY_FITS remains from the accepted Stata run: Appendix log warnings left the adjustment-cost fitted curve/confidence band absent from Figure_8_M1 and Figure_8_M2; no model or smoother change is made here.

analyses.label: Accepted Stata model simulations (Code/01-Models.do)
analyses.reason: The accepted stage is a synthetic-only model simulation analysis, not a dated observed sample. Code/01-Models.do imports author-generated simulation CSVs and sets t=_n; it derives firm from that model-period index and estimates/plots on simulated paths. The checked inputs are numeric simulation/statics files with no calendar, fiscal-year, or date field. The paper sample main is observed firm-year data for 1963–2014 and its Tables 7–8 belong to the separate Code/02-Compustat.do empirical route, which was not the accepted Stata stage. Thus there is no fit observation clock on which to pool five calendar years.

prior_gaps.description: The four assigned MATLAB SMM entrypoints remain unlaunched because required GA, Parallel Computing, and Statistics and Machine Learning functions are unavailable in the latest trusted MATLAB R2026b metadata. Although host batch CLI is installed and works, no MATLAB runtime was included in the frozen plan; private-home sign-in and cache-mount access remain unapproved.

The native Appendix log recorded “fracpoly could not fit model” for the Figure_8_M1 and Figure_8_M2 adjustment-cost panels (reviewed log lines 533 and 780). Root visual QA confirmed that each exported PDF has an empty middle “Adjustment costs” panel, so the requested fitted curve/confidence band is absent. The surrounding figure panels and files were produced; no model or smoother was changed.
